control_episodes_protocol.intent: Paired bundled-preset comparison; raw_frozen vs raw_free isolates wrist freezing, bigrun vs raw changes multiple controller settings.

storage_episodes_protocol.presets: same model-specific settings as the public CLI
storage_episodes_protocol.storage: matrix weights only, FP32 computation unchanged

perturbation_protocol.description: World-frame pelvis pushes at 1.0s for 0.2s, independent full first episodes, original model-specific control settings. No new motions or training seeds.

stress_protocol.description: Exploratory second stage, selected after observing no falls in the first 665 of 864 pre-specified 20/60/100 N cases. World-frame pelvis pushes at 1.0s for 0.2s; init frame 0 only; original model-specific controls. No new motions or training seeds.

stress_control_protocol.description: Exploratory extension chosen after the 400 N study showed different outcomes for models using different presets; FP32 only, paired conditions, no new training seeds.

counts.baseline_reuse_note: 32 basic t2 cases reused in the 96-row control comparison; 32 strong-force FP32 cases reused in the 96-row exploratory control comparison; force-zero baselines selected separately from basic/storage cases
